_comment: STRUCTURELONGTAILPLAN Phase B #27 — the Bog Trial. When the trial-chamber seed is thrown over BWG's pale_bog, the jigsaw grows BWG's own bog_trial (single design, referenced directly so its cosmetic aging processor rides along) in place of the Skyseed deep warren, seated at sink 1 (the throw-test tune). INERT without BWG: pale_bog cannot exist, so this band never matches and the normal trial chamber grows byte-identical. The bog_trial NBT carries its own trial spawners/vault, so no mob pack is needed. A blank jigsaw target reuses BWG's own start element + auto-centres it.
